01 — About

Where the model meets the factory floor.

I'm a BIM and light gauge steel framing detailer with 3+ years of experience building accurate 3D structural models in Vertex BD and SketchUp.

My focus is connection accuracy and quality checking — producing shop drawings, panel layouts and cutting lists that are ready to fabricate and easy to install.
